multiple_testing.family_scope: all tested factor/state/direction/horizon rows with matched residual p-value
multiple_testing.pvalue_method: one-sided positive matched-residual mean, normal approximation

factor_limitations.weekday: M77 replay cadence is weekly; weekday is diagnostic-only and cannot qualify for walk-forward promotion
factor_limitations.opex_phase_proxy: Monthly third-Friday proxy mapped to observed SPY sessions; not exact historical expiration authority
factor_limitations.aliasing: Exact cross-factor membership aliases are detected and both aliased factor-states are excluded from walk-forward qualification
factor_limitations.age_factors: Measured in consecutive replay observations, not daily trading sessions

matched_control.control_contract: same direction + M77.3 PIT regime + score band; tested temporal state excluded; raw underlying returns directionally aligned before comparison
